selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first three eligible scenes.

conflict_definition.cross_family_parent: One provider-bound parent contains proposals from at least two frozen action families.
conflict_definition.redundancy_eligible_conflict_parent: A cross-family parent also contains at least two proposals in one family, so SC28 may filter without weakening its redundancy gate.
conflict_definition.authority: Functional proposal label, proposal geometry, and parent OBB containment only. Description target IDs and selector outputs are forbidden.

post_admission.algorithm: Frozen SC28 redundancy-gated action-family witness before unchanged SC21 topology integrity.

forbidden_after_source_access: reorder candidates or skip an eligible scene
run task-relational, semantic, topology, or evaluator selection during admission
select scenes by target membership, wrong-part reduction, or algorithm outcome
claim_boundary: Provider-public source admission for a fresh redundancy-gated semantic-topology experiment. It uses privileged functional proposal labels and parent geometry but no task target membership or algorithm result. Passing admission is not algorithm success, RGB semantic proposal performance, reachability, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
